Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring automatic external defibrillators at public schools.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to automatic external defibrillators in publicschools; adding a new section to chapter 28A.210 RCW; and creating anew section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 28A.210RCW to read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Subject to funding provided by the state expressly for the purposesof this section, each school district board of directors shall: (1) Provide for an automatic external defibrillator to be locatedin each public school in the district; and (2) Comply with the requirements of RCW 70.54.310, includingtraining of personnel, use of the defibrillator, and notification ofthe local emergency medical services organization about the location ofthe defibrillator.

If specific funding for the purposes of thisact, referencing this act by bill or chapter number, is not provided by p. 1 HB 2488June 30, 2006, in the omnibus appropriations act, this act is null andvoid.
